record.name: Twenty
record.one_liner: Twenty is an open-source CRM platform with REST and GraphQL APIs, webhooks, OAuth 2.0, and an app framework for TypeScript developers.

auth.notes: Twenty supports OAuth 2.0 with authorization code + PKCE for user-facing apps, client credentials for server-to-server access, and dynamic client registration per RFC 7591. API keys are also available for internal scripts.

access.notes: Anyone can download or self-host Twenty, sign up for cloud plans without a credit card, or register OAuth clients dynamically.

api_surface.notes: Twenty exposes REST and GraphQL APIs, signed webhooks, and a TypeScript SDK for building custom apps and extensions.

mcp.notes: Twenty provides an MCP server as referenced on the pricing page.

buildability.reasoning: Twenty is open-source, self-hostable, provides self-serve cloud options, fully documented REST/GraphQL APIs, OAuth 2.0 with dynamic client registration, and a TypeScript SDK/scaffolding tool.
